/-- **Pullback along (the `hom` of) a scheme isomorphism is pushforward along its inverse.**
For a scheme isomorphism `e : W ≅ Z`, the module pullback `e.hom^*` is naturally isomorphic to the
pushforward `(e.inv)_*`: both are left adjoint to `(e.hom)_*` — the former by
`pullbackPushforwardAdjunction`, the latter because the pushforward equivalence
`pushforwardEquivOfIso e` makes `(e.inv)_* ⊣ (e.hom)_*` — so they agree by uniqueness of left
adjoints.  Project-local: the qcoh-transport device for pullback along isomorphisms
(`isQuasicoherent_pullback_of_iso`). -/
noncomputable def pullbackIsoPushforwardOfIso {W Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : W ≅ Z) :
    Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom ≅ Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.inv :=
  Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction e.hom)
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardEquivOfIso e).symm.toAdjunction

/-- **Pullback along a scheme isomorphism preserves quasi-coherence.**  Pullback along `e.hom` is
pushforward along `e.inv` (`pullbackIsoPushforwardOfIso`), and pushforward along a scheme iso
preserves quasi-coherence (`pushforward_iso_preserves_qcoh`); quasi-coherence is closed under
isomorphisms.  Project-local. -/
theorem isQuasicoherent_pullback_of_iso {W Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : W ≅ Z)
    (M : Z.Modules) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom).obj M).IsQuasicoherent := by
  have hpush : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.inv).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pushforward_iso_preserves_qcoh e.symm M hM
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent.{u} W.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    ((pullbackIsoPushforwardOfIso e).app M).symm hpush

/-- **Pullback between affine schemes preserves quasi-coherence** (Stacks 01BG, affine case).
For a morphism `k : W ⟶ Z` of affine schemes and `M` quasi-coherent on `Z`, the pullback `k^* M`
is quasi-coherent.  Route: conjugate `k` into a literal `Spec` morphism,
`k = W.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map φ ≫ Z.isoSpec.inv` with
`φ := Spec.preimage (W.isoSpec.inv ≫ k ≫ Z.isoSpec.hom)`; pullback along the two `isoSpec` legs
preserves quasi-coherence (`isQuasicoherent_pullback_of_iso`), and on the `Spec` leg the affine
structure theorem 01I8 (`qcoh_iso_tilde_sections`) turns the quasi-coherent module into a `tilde`,
whose pullback is again a `tilde` (`pullback_spec_tilde_iso`), hence quasi-coherent.  This is the
affine brick of the (Mathlib-absent) general "pullback preserves quasi-coherence"; the general
open-cover glue is not needed by the Čech base-change route, which only ever restricts to affine

    [IsAffine W] [IsAffine Z] (M : Z.Modules) (hM : M.IsQuasicoherent) :

    rw [Spec.map_preimage]

The workspace ledger is a single out-of-tree git (``.archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git``)

semantic message and the files it changed; Horizon stages them (respecting the
excludes), stamps ``Archon-Run``/``Session``/``Role``/``Task``/``Projects``
trailers from the run env, attributes the commit to the acting role, and
serialises against concurrent runs. It only ever commits — it never resets,
rebases, or rewrites history — so an agent cannot damage the ledger.

def _workspace_rel(files: list[str], root: Path) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
    """Resolve caller-supplied paths (relative to the shell cwd, or absolute) to
    workspace-relative posix paths. Returns ``(inside, outside)`` — paths outside
    the workspace are reported, not committed."""
    root_res = root.resolve()
    inside: list[str] = []
    outside: list[str] = []
    for f in files:
        p = Path(f)
        absolute = p if p.is_absolute() else (Path.cwd() / p)
        try:
            rel = absolute.resolve().relative_to(root_res)
        except ValueError:
            outside.append(f)
            continue
        inside.append(rel.as_posix())
    return inside, outside
